labels.label: cor:gap-nonneg
labels.notes: Unmarked (backticks only), REPORT row partial: correct. (a) gapNonneg_core / cor_gap_nonneg_a: hypothesis `(∃ c ≤ 0, R = c a.e.) ∨ EH g = Y g` is the paper's « constant R ≤ 0, or more generally a Yamabe metric ». Conjuncts 1-4 (δ ≥ 0; δ = 0 iff EH = Y ∧ Y = σ; iff EH = σ; δ = 0 ∧ R ≡ c ≤ 0 ⇒ σ ≤ 0) are proved from strict csc_yamabe_a and Y_le_sigma and do not depend on Einstein/ConstCurv at all: the paper's own inequality chain is genuinely proved. Conjunct 5 (Einstein, then constant curvature at N = 3) is exactly the application of the carried ExtremalA and EinsteinConstCurv3, which is the paper's own step (it cites thm:extremal (a) and asserts the 3-d fact). ExtremalA matches thm:extremal (a) l.209 in its σ ≤ 0 branch (Yamabe metric, Y = σ, σ ≤ 0 ⇒ Einstein). Predicate-argument design is disclosed in SCOPE with the kb/0095 triviality remark; it does not overclaim. Extra hypotheses: hb (Aubin's bound, a true cited fact), hC₀ (only Y(rep C₀) = Y g, weaker than membership), IsFiniteMeasure, hD; the σ-over-a-family reading is OQ-132 (b). (b) accel_gap reproduces eq:accel-gap from the carried AccelLaw exactly (k and δ as eq:gap-def). cor_gap_nonneg_b: thm:extremal (b) carried as hB at g0 with R ≡ R0 (σ arbitrary, so more general than σ(Σ)); proves the rescaled leaf g0' has R ≡ k and volume V_i, the FLRW family a² g0' has volume a^N V_i, ⟨R⟩ = k/a² (so −k/a² is −⟨R⟩, the curvature term of eq:accel-yamabe) and EH = σ, and δ/(V_i^{2/N} a²) = ⟨R⟩_FLRW − ⟨R_{g_t}⟩. homothety: R ↦ R/l and H ↦ H/√l are data because R is free data of CurvedMetric; these are the correct classical scaling laws, the paper does not prove them either (it uses them silently at l.244), volume scaling (vol_homothety) and EH invariance (closedEH_homothety, l.174) are derived, not defined. No hidden missing proof of the paper's. « constant curvature » of g0' read via constant scalar curvature: disclosed. Finding on l.244 (k = R of the rescaled metric, not of g0) is correct: k = R0 (V0/Vi)^{2/N} = R_{g0'}; notational.

labels.label: cor:volume
labels.notes: Unmarked, REPORT row partial: correct. cor_volume: R_g ≡ R_hyp ≡ c < 0 pointwise, N = 3, closed model; conclusion Vol(g_hyp) ≤ Vol(g) and (equal volumes ↔ Isometric g g_hyp). The inequality is proved from csc_yamabe_a, Y_le_sigma and the carried hB (thm:extremal (b) at g_hyp), independently of Einstein/ConstCurv/Isometric. The equality ⇒ isometric direction chains the carried ExtremalA, EinsteinConstCurv3, ConstCurv g_hyp and MostowAt exactly as the paper's proof (l.255-256); the converse is the carried hIsoVol (not argued in the paper, trivially true; disclosed). Hypotheses are jointly satisfiable (e.g. g = g_hyp with a one-class family; the witness checks the hB value on the toy model). « hyperbolic » read as supplied ConstCurv with R ≡ c < 0, R_hyp not normalised: disclosed, more general. EinsteinConstCurv3 is a fourth carried input beyond the dispatch's three named ones; it is disclosed in the docstring checklist, SCOPE and REPORT, it is a named Prop hypothesis (not an axiom, DEC-184), and the model has no curvature tensor, so it is acceptable. The REPORT's finding that the proof writes σ < 0 but only uses σ ≤ 0 is a correct remark, not a claimed error.
